plan: Given my private value of $48, I aim to bid just below my value to maximize potential profit while still having a strong chance of winning. Since the other bidders are rational, they are likely to bid close to their values. I will bid $47.9 to ensure I win if their values are slightly lower. This bid maximizes my chance of winning while keeping the cost low if I win.

My value for the prize is $38. To maximize profit, I should bid below my value but high enough to outbid others. Assuming rational behavior, other bidders will bid close to their values. A bid slightly above the midpoint of my value, say $30, could win if others have lower values. If I win, I pay the second-highest bid, maximizing profit if it's below $38.

Given my value of $12, I should aim to bid below my value to ensure profit if I win.
